default.children: Your case number is in the confirmation email we sent after you applied.

id.description: Unique ID for the panel. Close controls target this ID.

summaryProps.description: Props passed directly to the unstyled Summary trigger. Use label, children, ariaLabel, and className here. Defaults label to Open panel.

children.description: Optional semantic panel content, including forms, a Tree, lists, or nested Popovers.

menuItems.description: Rows for a stacked menu rendered in the panel before children. Each item sets `type`: "link" ({href, text}), "details" ({summaryProps, items}) which opens a nested Popover to the right, or "text" ({text}).

items.description: A link, details, or text row, chosen by `type`.

type.description: Required. Selects how the row renders.

id.description: Unique ID for a details row's panel. Defaults to the parent ID plus the row index.

summaryProps.description: Props passed to the details row summary. Only for type "details".

items.description: Nested menu rows with the same shape. Only for type "details".

side.description: Physical side of the trigger where CSS places the floating panel. Choose a side and alignment with enough space for the panel.

align.description: Alignment along the chosen side. Start and end follow text direction for top and bottom.

panelShape.description: Rounded keeps the original border radius and extra vertical padding; square removes the radius and uses equal outer padding on all sides. Nested menuItems flyouts inherit the shape.

defaultOpen.description: Open initially. Native details owns subsequent disclosure state.

name.description: Optional native details group: opening one closes another with the same name. Use unique group names for unrelated groups and each nesting level.

showClose.description: Add a visible close button after panel content. The shared enhancement enables it, outside dismissal, and Escape with focus return. The summary toggles natively without JavaScript.

closeLabel.description: Visible text for the optional close button.

panelHeading.description: Optional visible heading for the panel.

headingAs.description: Heading element used for panelHeading. Choose the level that fits the surrounding page outline.

scrollable.description: Bounds and enables scrolling on the panel content by adding the usx-popover__scroll class.

panelClassName.description: Additional classes for the popover panel, including custom sizing and spacing rules.

contentClassName.description: Optional class name for the inner content container.

extraAttributes.description: Additional HTML attributes on the popover root.
